text: AI coding assistants can search docs, inspect API schemas, generate integration code, and run live API calls from the editor
quote: Once connected, your AI assistant can search Lithic documentation, inspect endpoint schemas, generate integration code, and execute live API requests, all from within your editor.

text: Lithic MCP server integrates into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and other AI editors for live doc search and API calls
quote: Bring Lithic into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and other AI editors — search docs and run live API calls in flow.

text: MCP server lets AI agents act on findings using natural language, updating card program strategies and policies without dev involvement
quote: The MCP server now enables AI agents to act on what they find using natural language, eliminating reliance on developer teams to update your card program’s strategies, analytics, and policies.

text: Authorization Stream Access delivers real-time HTTP POST requests during authorization for custom approve/decline decisions
quote: ASA requests are delivered as an HTTP POST request during authorization. The request body includes transaction metadata... Your endpoint should respond with HTTP status 200 and the approval decision

text: Custom authorization logic can be applied at the program, account, or card level
quote: Rules can be applied at three entity levels: Program level: across the entire card program, Account level: to specific accounts, Card level: to specific cards

text: Shadow mode lets draft rules observe live authorization traffic without affecting outcomes, with backtesting/performance reports to measure impact
quote: shadow mode lets draft rules observe the authorization stream without affecting outcomes, while performance reports and backtesting measure impact over time

text: Sandbox has extra endpoints to simulate merchant-acquirer transaction events
quote: The sandbox environment has additional endpoints to simulate transaction events originating from a merchant acquirer.

text: Users can register/manage webhook URLs, replay messages, control subscription secrets, and search past events
quote: you can register and manage webhook URLs, replay webhook messages, control event subscription secrets, and search past events

text: API requests can specify a dated api-version header to control which API version serves them
quote: Send the `api-version` request header with the version you want

text: KYC_BYO lets pre-approved API users bypass Lithic's KYC process to create an individual account
quote: KYC_BYO allows an API user to bypass the Lithic KYC process and create an individual account (available only to users with KYC processes pre-approved by Lithic)

text: Create a new virtual or physical card via a single API call, with shipping address and product_id for physical cards
quote: Create a new virtual or physical card. Parameters `shipping_address` and `product_id` only apply to physical cards.

text: Lithic can handle network chargeback filing and representment responses on behalf of the customer
quote: Lithic can help power your cardholders' disputes by handling networking filing for chargebacks and representment responses.

text: Customers submit dispute details and evidence, and Lithic files the chargeback with the network
quote: You provide the dispute details (e.g. amount and reason) as well as supporting documents, and Lithic submits the chargeback to the network on your behalf.

text: Digital card art for the wallet must be Mastercard-approved and configured by Lithic for tokenization display
quote: Specifies the digital card art to be displayed in the user’s digital wallet after tokenization. This artwork must be approved by Mastercard and configured by Lithic to use.

text: Sandbox testing flow: create a card, configure authorization rules on merchant category/limits/velocity, and run test transactions against them
quote: Create a virtual card and assign it to a test account... Configure Authorization Rules controlling merchant categories, transaction limits, and velocity... Run transactions against those rules

text: Marketing claim of autonomous issuing, payments, and controls purpose-built for AI-powered workflows
quote: Make the leap from insights to action with secure and autonomous issuing, payments, and controls for AI-powered workflows.

text: Card and account spend limits provide basic controls to manage spend velocity
quote: Lithic's Card and Account Spend Limits provide basic controls that help customers manage spend velocity.

text: Sandbox environment mirrors production, letting users run cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end
quote: A safe environment mirroring production — run cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end.

text: Authorization Stream Access exposes an HTTP interface to the ISO 8583 message stream for custom approval decisions
quote: Authorization Stream Access (ASA) provides the ability to make custom transaction approval decisions through an HTTP interface to the ISO 8583 message stream.

text: Custom authorization logic can be enforced at program, account, or card level without managing extra infrastructure
quote: you can enforce business-specific authorization logic at the program, account, or card level, without managing additional infrastructure

text: Complex authorization logic can be written in TypeScript, compiled to WebAssembly, and run in the Rules Engine
quote: write authorization logic in TypeScript that compiles to WebAssembly and runs in the Rules Engine, for logic that cannot be expressed as a set of conditions

text: Developers can select a dated API version to control when API changes reach their integration
quote: Choose which dated version of the Lithic API serves your requests, and control when changes reach your integration.

text: Interactive editor can execute live Lithic API requests directly using an API key
quote: Execute live API requests: call the Lithic API directly from your editor (requires a Lithic API key)
